functions.description: Parse core Tenable SC admin log structure into named fields, capturing any trailing key=value pairs into a scratch field
Extract optional trailing key=value pairs (session_id, scan_id, target_user, report_id, attempts, token_id, repo_id, scanner_uuid) from scratch field
Normalize severity casing and classify event outcome (success/failure) for downstream mapping
Clean up scratch field used to hold unparsed trailing key-value pairs
